_comment: Every coefficient used by simulate.py and evaluate.py. Values marked PLACEHOLDER are demo defaults to recalibrate from the full one-year datasets or local surveys; sources are indicative, not citations.

demand._comment: Daily volumes are MEASURED, not set here: simulate.py reads them from data/calibration.json (built by trips.py from the observed bike_trips.geojson, ~11-12 trips/day). Larger volumes are explicit growth hypotheses passed as --scale; the labels below are the ones the demo presents. The behavioural parameters remain ASSUMED.

rebalancing._comment: dispatch_fixed_cost_eur and unit_cost_eur_per_bike_km are read at runtime from network-design-bss/src/util/cost.py (CostParameters.dispatch_fixed_cost, .rebalancing_unit_cost), not set here. truck_capacity_bikes (here) and, in the demand block, walk_catchment_m and ride_speed_kmh mirror network-design-bss/src/util/util.py (CAPACITY_REBALANCING_VEHICLE, WALK_CATCHMENT_RADIUS, RIDE_SPEED respectively) and are pinned by demo/experiments/tests/test_src_parity.py.

costs._comment: station_setup_cost_eur, dock_cost_eur and unit_bike_cost_eur are read at runtime from network-design-bss/src/util/cost.py (CostParameters), not set here, so simulated CAPEX can never silently drift from what the optimiser spent. truck_capacity_bikes (in rebalancing) and, in the demand block, walk_catchment_m and ride_speed_kmh mirror network-design-bss/src/util/util.py (CAPACITY_REBALANCING_VEHICLE, WALK_CATCHMENT_RADIUS, RIDE_SPEED respectively) and are pinned by demo/experiments/tests/test_src_parity.py.

mode_substitution._comment: What a served bike-share trip replaces. PLACEHOLDER: mid-range of European bike-share user surveys (car share is deliberately conservative for a dense city centre). Must sum to 1.

unserved_fallback._comment: What an unserved would-be rider does instead. Must sum to 1.

emission_factors_g_per_pkm._comment: Lifecycle gCO2e per passenger-km, mobitool-style Swiss values. Bike fleet factor is the observed mix: 75% mechanical (8 g) / 25% e-bike (25 g).
